sources.title: Stephen Boyd and Lieven Vandenberghe, Convex Optimization (full textbook)
sources.locator: Full 714-page textbook; complete cited reasoning inspected at each item locator.

read_evidence.method: Downloaded the full official PDF, extracted it with MuPDF, and inspected the complete cited sections and proof passages.

contents.name: Barrier definitions, central paths, and exact gap
contents.support: Smooth inequality and conic central points, dual multipliers, and exact m/t or cone-degree/t gaps.

contents.name: Central-path exact gap proof
contents.support: Central-point dual construction and exact gap; the carrier supplies the full derivation under its actual hypotheses.

contents.name: Conic barrier-gradient duality
contents.support: Generalized logarithms have dual-cone gradients and the log-homogeneous Euler identity.

contents.name: Self-concordance and local Newton geometry
contents.locator: Chapter 9 §9.6.4 and Chapter 11 §11.5, printed pp. 503–510 and 585–596
contents.support: Self-concordance assumptions, local metric, and short-step analysis; all local inequalities used in the carrier are proved there.

contents.name: Local damped Newton estimates
contents.locator: Chapter 9 §9.6.4 and Chapter 11 §11.5.2, printed pp. 503–510 and 587–590
contents.support: Damped Newton decrement and recentering context; the exact two-correction bound is derived locally.

contents.name: Orthant logarithmic barrier
contents.locator: Chapter 11 §11.5.1 and Chapter 11 §11.6.1, printed pp. 586–587 and 597
contents.support: The orthant log barrier and its barrier parameter.

contents.name: Lorentz barrier
contents.support: Lorentz logarithm and degree two; the carrier proves self-duality and its mixed self-concordance bound.

contents.name: PSD cone and logdet barrier
contents.locator: Chapter 5 §5.9.1, printed pp. 265–266; Chapter 11 §11.6.1 and §11.6.4, pp. 598–601 and 606
contents.support: PSD dual cone, matrix log barrier, derivative and barrier degree; the carrier derives the full Hessian and third-derivative estimates.

contents.name: Conic formulations and duality
contents.locator: Chapter 4 §4.6, printed pp. 166–170; Chapter 5 §5.9.1, printed pp. 264–266; Chapter 11 §11.6, pp. 596–601
contents.support: SOCP/SDP primal-dual forms, generalized-cone multipliers, and weak-duality signs.

contents.name: Phase I and feasibility status
contents.support: Feasibility and conic Phase-I interpretations; the carrier proves the zero-margin ambiguity.

contents.name: Short-step path following
contents.support: Path-following update, centrality, and O(sqrt(nu) log(nu/epsilon)) framework; local constants are proved in the carrier.

contents.name: Short-step complexity theorem
contents.support: Newton-step complexity and central-path gap framework; the carrier proves the stated update and error bound.

contents.name: Primal-dual residual system and line search
contents.support: Modified KKT residuals, primal-dual Newton derivative, and fraction-to-boundary convention.

contents.name: Primal-dual Newton method
contents.support: Primal-dual residual equations and line-search/status context; finite precision conditions are supplied by verified NA02 items.

contents.name: Primal-dual gap certificate
contents.support: Surrogate gap needs exact primal-dual feasibility; generalized-cone weak duality.

contents.name: LP/QP Newton matrix
contents.support: Newton derivative blocks; nonsingularity is proved independently in the carrier.

contents.name: Inexact centering caveat
contents.support: Exact central point gap versus inexact centering; actual numerical distance bound is imported from OPT0.

contents.name: SOCP robust formulation
contents.support: Second-order-cone epigraph; the norm-bounded matrix-perturbation identity is derived exactly in the example.

contents.name: Boundary Hessian conditioning
contents.support: Barrier central path and boundary behavior; the conditioning calculation is exact and local.

contents.name: Strict and weak SDP feasibility
contents.support: Phase-I limitations for cone feasibility; the affine slice and distance calculation are verified exactly.

contents.name: Resource allocation central path
contents.support: LP central-point gap and short-step context; exact candidate values are recalculated.

contents.name: LP residual and exact gap trace
contents.support: Residual and dual-gap conventions; all candidate values are recomputed exactly.

contents.name: Small SDP relaxation
contents.support: SDP lift and dual certificate format; the example verifies both values directly.
